name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: The line chart with its area filled down to the baseline in a fading gradient.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after the value in the tooltip ("orders").

props.name: area
props.description: Fill under the line. `AreaCard` sets it.

props.name: labelEvery
props.description: Show every nth x label, counted back from the last point (3 for every third month of a year). Left out, about seven labels spread across the plot (five when they are dates).

props.name: reducedMotion
props.description: Swap the plot without the fade when the data changes, as under prefers-reduced-motion.

AreaCard.description: The Line chart with the gradient under its line.
